# Tech-selskaber til eksamen - kan de løfte eller sænke markedet?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Euroinvestor Millionærklubben episode, with Sydbank chief analyst Natalia Zetlak and Horizon 3 CIO Henrik Carlsen, looks ahead to Q3 earnings season. Both expect earnings to stay strong, with S&P 500 growth of about 25-30%. Tech and hyperscaler AI capex are the main drivers, and higher rates and oil prices are the main headwinds. Horizon 3 has trimmed its memory-chip holdings (Micron, SK Hynix) because it doubts memory prices can keep rising. It favours Broadcom, Nvidia and cybersecurity but says cybersecurity is expensive in the short term, and it continues to stay out of Meta.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 MU — Micron | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest (Horizon 3) took profits 10 days ago; position smaller but still held. Low P/E but memory-price peak risk.

#### Reasoning

P/E is only 4-6 after a record quarter, and strategic customer agreements (about 35% of capacity) set a floor. But chip-sector growth of 92% is mostly memory price inflation (real growth about 22%), and data points to a chip-market decline in 2028 driven by memory prices. Given the cyclical history, the fund is trimming but staying invested.

#### Sell Triggers

- memory prices plateau or fall
- hyperscaler capex shifts away from memory
- new Chinese competition (CXMT) erodes pricing

> *"vi er faktisk også begyndt at tage gevinster hjem for en uge, 10 dage siden på Micron og Heinex"*

---

### 🟡 000660.KS — SK Hynix | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest trimmed the position; still held, smaller than a month ago. Earnings are on the watchlist.

#### Reasoning

Same memory thesis as Micron: cheap valuation and structural AI demand, offset by the risk that memory prices peak and by the cyclical history. The position has been reduced.

#### Sell Triggers

- memory price peak
- weak upcoming SK Hynix earnings
- Chinese competition

> *"vi har stadig både Heinex og Microniportifølje, men de fylder mindre, end de gjorde for en måned siden"*

---

### 🟢 AVGO — Broadcom | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest wants exposure: custom ASICs for inference; the ASIC market is expected to exceed GPUs from 2030; the stock has lagged this year.

#### Reasoning

Hyperscalers like Microsoft are moving to in-house inference chips, which is where Broadcom is strong. Analysis suggests the ASIC market overtakes GPUs around 2030, and the stock hasn't risen much this year, so the guest sees an attractive entry.

#### Sell Triggers

- hyperscaler custom-chip programmes slow
- AI capex cuts

> *"Det er en aktie, der ikke er steget ret meget i år af forskellige årsager. Så der vil vi gerne være."*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest finds it attractive relative to pricing, given guidance of at least 70% revenue growth next year.

#### Reasoning

Nvidia has guided to at least 70% revenue growth next year and launched a record buyback. Horizon 3 sees the valuation as reasonable relative to growth within selective AI-infrastructure exposure.

#### Sell Triggers

- hyperscaler capex reduction
- China export restrictions
- growth guidance cut

> *"det synes vi jo stadigvæk ser spændende ud i forhold til, hvad den er prissat til"*

---

### 🟡 MSFT — Microsoft | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Held by guest; clearer AI monetisation, in-house Maia chip, largest cyber exposure; up 35% in Q3.

#### Reasoning

Microsoft orchestrates around 1,200 models, monetises AI more clearly than Meta, and its in-house Maia chip cuts costs. The fund held through the Q1 fear wave and was rewarded.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI capex fails to monetise
- cloud growth slows

---

### ⛔ META — Meta | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest hasn't owned it in 3 years because monetisation is less clear, though Muse and sales of data-centre capacity could change that.

#### Reasoning

Horizon 3 sees AI-investment monetisation as clearer at Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet than at Meta. Muse and external data-centre capacity sales could become monetisable, which makes it interesting, but the fund has declined to buy so far.

#### Sell Triggers

- clear Muse monetisation
- meaningful external data-centre revenue

> *"der har vi jo også takket nej til den indtil videre"*

---

### 🟠 ARM — ARM | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Guest finds it interesting but somewhat expensive.

#### Reasoning

ARM is on Horizon 3's radar as part of selective AI-infrastructure exposure, but the valuation looks rich.

#### Sell Triggers

- valuation stays stretched

> *"en virksomhed som ARM er spændende, og mænden er lidt dyr"*

---

### 🟡 NET — Cloudflare | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

About 2% of Horizon 3's AUM. Cyber has structural tailwinds and is a priority spend, but valuations are high short term.

#### Reasoning

Cybersecurity is the spending area companies won't cut, and budgets are rising next year. Many names have no debt, generate cash and offer long compounding runways. The only negative is pricing after a rally of 100% or more from the March low, which leaves room for pullbacks.

#### Sell Triggers

- valuation-driven pullback
- cyber budget cuts

> *"Jamen, det er positivt langsigtet."*

---

### 🟡 CRWD — CrowdStrike | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Held by guest; one of the most expensive stocks on P/E, but structural cyber tailwind.

#### Reasoning

Part of a cyber basket with a positive long-term view. P/E is very high, which creates short-term downside risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- valuation compression
- growth slowdown

> *"Crowdstrike er måske en af de dyreste aktiemål på p"*

---
